parsed.summary: The PR adds a new hook `get_inlines` to `ModelAdmin` to allow dynamic inlines based on the request or model instance. It includes tests for the new functionality.

issues.description: The new `get_inlines` method is added, but it does not follow the naming convention of other similar methods in `ModelAdmin` (e.g., `get_queryset`, `get_list_display`). It might be more consistent to name it `get_inline_classes` to match the naming pattern.
The PR does not update the documentation for `ModelAdmin` to include the new `get_inlines` method. Adding a docstring to the method and updating the relevant documentation would be beneficial.
